why: An August 2025 arXiv preprint by Malkoun (2508.13472) generalizes the Atiyah problem on configurations and the Atiyah-Sutcliffe conjectures 1 and 2 using finite graphs, configurations of points and tensors; it is unclear from search results alone whether this proves new cases of the original conjecture or only studies a generalized variant, so scope cannot be confirmed without reading it. All other results found (Eastwood-Norbury 2001, Malkoun's alternate n=4 proof 2022/2023) predate the January 2024 snapshot.
